import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    "m": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main",
    "r": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships",
}

def col_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r"([A-Z]+)(\d+)", ref)
    letters, row = m.groups()
    col = 0
    for ch in letters:
        col = col * 26 + (ord(ch) - ord("A") + 1)
    return col, int(row)

with zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx") as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Files in archive:", names)

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml"))
        for si in root.findall("m:si", NS):
            shared.append("".join(t.text or "" for t in si.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t")))

    # workbook sheet list
    wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/workbook.xml"))
    sheets = wb_root.findall("m:sheets/m:sheet", NS)
    print("Sheets:", [(s.get("name"), s.get("sheetId")) for s in sheets])

    for sheet in sheets:
        name = sheet.get("name")
        rid = sheet.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id")
        rels = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels"))
        target = None
        for rel in rels:
            if rel.get("Id") == rid:
                target = rel.get("Target")
        if target is None:
            continue
        path = "xl/" + target.lstrip("/")
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        print(f"\n=== Sheet: {name} ===")
        for row in root.findall("m:sheetData/m:row", NS):
            for c in row.findall("m:c", NS):
                ref = c.get("r")
                t = c.get("t")
                v = c.find("m:v", NS)
                val = None
                if t == "s" and v is not None:
                    val = shared[int(v.text)]
                elif t == "inlineStr":
                    is_el = c.find("m:is", NS)
                    val = "".join(x.text or "" for x in is_el.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t"))
                elif v is not None:
                    val = v.text
                print(f"{ref}: {val!r} (type={t})")
